import sys
from collections import deque

MAXN = 256
MAXT = 64
MAXE = MAXN * MAXN
INF = 1000000000

class Edge:
    def __init__(self, u, v, f, c, nx):
        self.u = u
        self.v = v
        self.f = f
        self.c = c
        self.nx = nx

class Dinic:
    def __init__(self):
        self.e = [None] * MAXE
        self.n = 0
        self.m = 0
        self.src = 0
        self.dst = 0
        self.head = [-1] * MAXN
        self.work = [0] * MAXN
        self.d = [-1] * MAXN

    def init(self, n, src, dst):
        self.n = n
        self.src = src
        self.dst = dst
        self.m = 0
        for i in range(n):
            self.head[i] = -1

    def addEdge(self, u, v, c):
        self.e[self.m] = Edge(u, v, 0, c, self.head[u])
        self.head[u] = self.m
        self.m += 1
        self.e[self.m] = Edge(v, u, 0, 0, self.head[v])
        self.head[v] = self.m
        self.m += 1

    def _bfs(self):
        q = deque()
        for i in range(self.n):
            self.d[i] = -1
        self.d[self.src] = 0
        q.append(self.src)
        while q:
            k = q.popleft()
            i = self.head[k]
            while i != -1:
                e = self.e[i]
                if e.f < e.c and self.d[e.v] == -1:
                    self.d[e.v] = self.d[k] + 1
                    q.append(e.v)
                i = e.nx
        return self.d[self.dst] != -1

    def _dfs(self, u, f):
        if u == self.dst:
            return f
        i = self.work[u]
        while i != -1:
            e = self.e[i]
            if e.f < e.c and self.d[e.v] == self.d[u] + 1:
                minf = self._dfs(e.v, min(f, e.c - e.f))
                if minf > 0:
                    e.f += minf
                    self.e[i ^ 1].f -= minf
                    return minf
            i = e.nx
            self.work[u] = i
        return 0

    def maxFlow(self):
        ret = 0
        while self._bfs():
            for i in range(self.n):
                self.work[i] = self.head[i]
            while True:
                delta = self._dfs(self.src, INF)
                if delta == 0:
                    break
                ret += delta
        return ret

def isalpha(c):
    return c.isalpha()

def isdigit(c):
    return c.isdigit()

n, t = 0, 0
smp = []
cmp = []
work = []
vis = []

dx = [1, 0, -1, 0]
dy = [0, -1, 0, 1]

def X(i, j):
    return i * n + j

def Y(i, j):
    return n * n + i * n + j

def S():
    return n * n * 2

def T():
    return S() + 1

def N():
    return T() + 1

def bfs(sx, sy):
    global vis, work
    q = deque()
    vis[sx][sy] = 1
    q.append((sx, sy, 0, 0))
    q.append((zx, zy, 0, 1))
    while q:
        u_x, u_y, u_t, u_type = q.popleft()
        if u_t == t:
            break
        if u_type == 0 and isalpha(work[u_x][u_y]):
            continue
        for i in range(4):
            nx = u_x + dx[i]
            ny = u_y + dy[i]
            if 0 <= nx < n and 0 <= ny < n:
                if u_type == 0 and not vis[nx][ny] and not isalpha(work[nx][ny]):
                    vis[nx][ny] = 1
                    q.append((nx, ny, u_t + 1, 0))
                elif u_type == 1 and not isalpha(work[nx][ny]):
                    work[nx][ny] = 'Z'
                    q.append((nx, ny, u_t + 1, 1))

def main():
    global n, t, smp, cmp, work, vis, zx, zy
    input_lines = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    index = 0
    while index < len(input_lines):
        line = input_lines[index].strip()
        if not line:
            index += 1
            continue
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) < 2:
            index += 1
            continue
        n, t = map(int, parts)
        index += 1
        dinic = Dinic()
        dinic.init(N(), S(), T())
        smp = []
        cmp = []
        for i in range(n):
            smp.append(list(input_lines[index]))
            index += 1
        for i in range(n):
            cmp.append(list(input_lines[index]))
            index += 1
        zx, zy = -1, -1
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if isdigit(smp[i][j]) and smp[i][j] > '0':
                    dinic.addEdge(S(), X(i, j), int(smp[i][j]))
                elif smp[i][j] == 'Z':
                    zx, zy = i, j
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if isdigit(cmp[i][j]) and cmp[i][j] > '0':
                    dinic.addEdge(Y(i, j), T(), int(cmp[i][j]))
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(n):
                if not (isdigit(smp[i][j]) and smp[i][j] > '0'):
                    continue
                vis = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]
                work = [row[:] for row in smp]
                bfs(i, j)
                for xi in range(n):
                    for yi in range(n):
                        if not (isdigit(cmp[xi][yi]) and cmp[xi][yi] > '0'):
                            continue
                        if vis[xi][yi]:
                            dinic.addEdge(X(i, j), Y(xi, yi), INF)
        print(dinic.maxFlow())

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
